# PrimeBlocks

The ultimate collection of UI blocks crafted with Tailwind CSS to build spectacular applications in no time.

PrimeBlocks is a separate **commercial product** by PrimeTek — a collection of ready-to-use UI blocks crafted with Tailwind CSS. **Note:** the current product (primeblocks.org) is a Nuxt/**PrimeVue** site (574 `primevue` refs, 0 `angular`/`primeng` in the bundle); blocks are Tailwind markup demoed in PrimeVue, so for MeeSell (Angular/PrimeNG) they are **layout references**, not drop-in. The site is a client-rendered SPA — the catalog menu cannot be statically scraped.

## Captured pages

- **[free-blocks.md](free-blocks.md)** — the **Free Blocks** showcase (`/free`), rendered via headless browser: 13 free sample blocks (auth, dashboard stats, data display, marketing/pricing) mapped to MeeSell screens. Screenshot: `free-blocks-screenshot.png`.

The paid catalog (Application / Marketing / Ecommerce groups) requires an all-access license and is behind the SPA; not captured.
